title: Equivalent Asymptotic Bounds for the Probability Deficit
statement: For each block width $w$, let $N_w$ be the critical tribes dimension and let $d_w$ be its probability deficit from $1/2$. The function $\log(N_w)/N_w$ is $O(d_w)$ as $w\to\infty$ if and only if it is $O((1/2+d_w)-1/2)$ as $w\to\infty$.
